title: BioLayers AI cells: IXMtest_A02_s1_w1051DAA7C-7042-435F-99F0-1E847D9B42CB.tif
disclaimer: Research and educational system. Not a clinical diagnostic.

image.coordinates: x = column, y = row, origin top-left, pixels

overlays.format: RGBA PNG at image resolution; opaque outline, translucent fill, transparent background; colour = label

evidence_levels.observed_directly_in_image: Observed directly in the image (measured from segmented pixels)
evidence_levels.supported_by_literature: Supported by published literature (not observed in this image)
evidence_levels.inferred_by_model: Inferred by a model or rule (not an experimental fact)

segmentation.model: Cellpose, pretrained cpsam_v2 weights (zero-shot, no fine-tuning)
segmentation.confidence: per cell: mean Cellpose cell probability inside the mask (uncalibrated, tends to saturate near 0.95-0.97)
segmentation.dataset: BBBC039 (200 images, U2OS nuclei, Hoechst) and CTC PhC-C2DH-U373 (2 sequences)
limitations: Benchmarked on two public datasets only; performance on other stains, magnifications or cell types is unmeasured.
The cell probability is the model's own score, not a calibrated error rate.

tracking.model: BioLayers overlap tracker (Hungarian assignment on mask IoU + gap/flicker clean-up)
tracking.confidence: per track: mean IoU between the cell's masks in consecutive frames
tracking.dataset: CTC PhC-C2DH-U373, training sequences 01 and 02 (230 frames)
limitations: Own CTC-style metrics, not the official CTC evaluation software.
Division detection is only shown not to invent divisions; these sequences contain no real divisions, so its recall is unmeasured.
Mean speeds run ~12% below ground truth (centroid vs hand-placed marker jitter).

phenotype_rules.model: Rule-based phenotype classifier (transparent thresholds, not a learned model)
phenotype_rules.confidence: per label: rule margin, the deciding feature's distance from its threshold mapped to 0.5-0.99 (not a probability)
phenotype_rules.dataset: no labelled phenotype data exists for these classes; thresholds set from cell-size units, not fitted to data

evaluation_metric.note: checks that tracking errors do not change the label; it does not validate the biology

limitations: No biological ground truth: the rules have not been validated against expert labels.
'quiescent' means not migrating and not seen dividing; cell-cycle quiescence (G0) is not observable in phase contrast.
Abnormal-morphology flags are population outliers, so they depend on which cells are in the population.

literature_linker.model: Curated knowledge base, manual curation (no text mining, no language model)
literature_linker.confidence: not scored: each link cites the PubMed-verified paper it rests on
literature_linker.evaluation_metric: each statement checked against its PubMed abstract
limitations: Links describe what is known about the cell type or pathway in general; they are never evidence about the specific cell in the image.
Only the 'migrating' phenotype has curated links in this release.

note: Rules R-ABN and R-PYK were designed for nuclear-stain images. No literature links are attached to single-frame flags in this release.
